title: 综合题：串联谐振支路与各表读数
statement: 求三只表的读数和电源发出的平均功率。

questions.ask: 电流表 A_1 的读数 = ?
电流表 A_2 的读数 = ?
电源吸收的平均功率 P_us = ?（负值表示发出）

hints: 三个分量分别作用。直流时 C_1 开路；先算出 3ωL_1 与 1/(3ωC_1)，看看 L_{1}C_1 支路对 3 次谐波是什么状态。
基波：L_{1}C_1 支路的阻抗是 j(10 − 90) = −j80 Ω，与 R_2 并联后再与 R_1 串联。
3 次谐波时 L_{1}C_1 支路相当于短路：A_2、V 中都没有 3 次谐波，全部 3 次谐波电流走 A_1。最后各表按平方和开方合成。

en.title: Comprehensive: a series-resonant branch and the meter readings
statement: u_s = 30 + 120√2 cos(1000t) + 60√2 cos(3000t) V, R_1 = 10 Ω, R_2 = 20 Ω, L_1 = 10 mH, C_1 = 11.11 µF (ωL_1 = 10 Ω, 1/(ωC_1) = 90 Ω). The ammeters A_1, A_2 and the voltmeter V read rms values.
Find the three readings and the average power delivered by the source.
hints: Let the three components act separately. At DC C_1 is open; compute 3ωL_1 and 1/(3ωC_1) and see what the L_{1}C_1 branch does at the 3rd harmonic.
Fundamental: the L_{1}C_1 branch has impedance j(10 − 90) = −j80 Ω, in parallel with R_2 and then in series with R_1.
At the 3rd harmonic the L_{1}C_1 branch is a short: A_2 and V see no 3rd harmonic and the whole 3rd-harmonic current goes through A_1. Finally combine each reading as a root of a sum of squares.
solution: **1. DC** (C_1 open, no current in A_1): I_0 = 30/(10 + 20) = 1 A, 1 A in A_2, U_a0 = 20 V.
**3. 3rd harmonic** (3ωL_1 = 30 Ω, 1/(3ωC_1) = 30 Ω): L_{1}C_1 is in series resonance — a short, U_a3 = 0; A_1 carries 60/10 = 6 A, A_2 and V see no 3rd harmonic.
**Check (harmonic by harmonic at the source):** P = 30 × 1 + 120 × 4.109 × cos 9.27° + 60 × 6 = 30 + 486.6 + 360 = 876.6 W — the same.

questions.explain: DC: C_1 open, 0; fundamental: 0.9965 A; 3rd harmonic: L_{1}C_1 is in series resonance (a short), I = 60/10 = 6 A. Reading √(0.9965² + 6²) = 6.082 A.
DC 30/(10 + 20) = 1 A; fundamental 3.986 A; at the 3rd harmonic node a is shorted to ground, 0. Reading √(1² + 3.986²) = 4.110 A.

questions.ask: Average power absorbed by the source, P_us = ? (negative = delivered)
questions.explain: The source delivers 876.6 W, all dissipated in R_1 (538.8 W) and R_2 (337.8 W).
